test_title: Cold launch with no existing save
preconditions: Fresh profile; first-run setup has not been completed
test_steps:
1. Start the game from the platform client.
2. Observe startup logos and first-run prompts.
3. Reach the title screen.
expected_result: Launch completes without a crash; required prompts can be completed or dismissed; main-menu input is accepted.

test_title: Return to title after ending a session
preconditions: A playable session is active
test_steps:
1. Pause the session.
2. Select return to title.
3. Confirm exit.
4. Start a new session.
expected_result: The previous session closes cleanly; no gameplay input remains active on the menu; a new session starts without restarting the application.

test_title: Close application during a loading transition
preconditions: A saved session exists; loading a level is possible
test_steps:
1. Begin loading a saved session.
2. Close the application during loading.
3. Relaunch.
4. Inspect the available saves.
expected_result: The application relaunches; the last completed save remains readable; no partially written save is presented as valid.

test_title: Remap movement key and restore defaults
preconditions: Keyboard input enabled; controls menu available
test_steps:
1. Assign movement-left to a free key.
2. Return to gameplay.
3. Test the new binding.
4. Restore defaults.
5. Test again.
expected_result: The new key performs the action; the old key stops triggering it if unassigned; restoring defaults returns the original bindings.

test_title: Reject conflicting key assignments consistently
preconditions: Two distinct actions can be rebound
test_steps:
1. Assign the same key to action A and action B.
2. Observe any warning.
3. Confirm or cancel.
4. Reopen bindings.
expected_result: The game applies its documented conflict rule; displayed bindings match actual input; no action becomes inaccessible without warning.

test_title: Controller disconnect during active movement
preconditions: Controller connected and gameplay active
test_steps:
1. Hold movement input.
2. Disconnect controller.
3. Reconnect.
4. Resume moving.
expected_result: Movement stops when input is lost; a clear reconnect prompt appears if required; controls recover without a stuck input.

test_title: Rapid alternating movement and interaction
preconditions: Character is next to an interactable object
test_steps:
1. Alternate movement directions rapidly.
2. Press interact at varied points in the movement animation.
3. Repeat 20 times.
expected_result: Interactions occur only inside the valid range and state; character movement and interaction animation do not lock up.

test_title: Input blocked while pause menu is open
preconditions: Player can move and use an item; session can be paused
test_steps:
1. Open pause menu.
2. Press movement, attack, and item-use controls.
3. Close menu.
expected_result: No gameplay action occurs while paused in a single-player session; focus returns to gameplay on resume.

test_title: Jump on the last valid frame before leaving ledge
preconditions: Level contains a safe ledge and jump action
test_steps:
1. Approach the ledge at walking speed.
2. Trigger jump immediately before falling.
3. Repeat from the same position.
expected_result: Jump is accepted within the game's documented grounded or grace-period window; no unexpected double jump is introduced.

test_title: Collision against narrow doorway
preconditions: Character can enter a doorway close to its collision width
test_steps:
1. Approach doorway from center.
2. Approach from both side angles.
3. Repeat while carrying an item.
expected_result: The character passes where visible clearance allows; collision does not permit clipping through nearby walls.

test_title: Moving platform carries an idle character
preconditions: Moving platform can be reached
test_steps:
1. Stand motionless at the center.
2. Ride through a full platform cycle.
3. Repeat near an edge.
expected_result: Character follows platform motion consistently; collision remains stable; no unexpected sliding or falling occurs.

test_title: Stun and movement state reset
preconditions: An enemy can interrupt the character with a stun
test_steps:
1. Start sprinting.
2. Receive a stun.
3. Wait until recovery.
4. Move and sprint again.
expected_result: Stun prevents prohibited actions only for its intended duration; movement speed and control flags reset after recovery.

test_title: Interact just inside and outside activation radius
preconditions: A fixed object displays an interaction prompt
test_steps:
1. Approach until prompt appears.
2. Interact.
3. Step outside range.
4. Try again.
expected_result: Interaction works within range; prompt and action both deactivate outside range; no remote activation is possible.

test_title: Interact with a door while another action is playing
preconditions: Character can use a tool beside an unlocked door
test_steps:
1. Begin tool-use animation.
2. Press interact during animation.
3. Retry immediately after animation ends.
expected_result: Door interaction follows animation priority rules; input does not cause duplicated state changes or frozen animations.

test_title: Destroy object while inventory is full
preconditions: Inventory is at capacity; object would drop loot
test_steps:
1. Fill all inventory slots.
2. Destroy loot-bearing object.
3. Inspect ground and inventory.
expected_result: Loot handling matches design (dropped, queued, or clearly rejected); no silent item loss or duplication occurs.

test_title: Drag item between occupied slots
preconditions: Two distinct items occupy inventory slots
test_steps:
1. Drag item A onto item B.
2. Inspect both slots.
3. Close and reopen inventory.
expected_result: Items swap or follow the documented merge rule; quantities and item identities remain unchanged.

test_title: Split a stack of one item
preconditions: Inventory contains one item in a stackable slot
test_steps:
1. Open split-stack action.
2. Enter zero then one as split amount if allowed.
3. Confirm or cancel.
expected_result: Invalid split quantities are rejected; total item count stays one; no empty duplicate stack appears.

test_title: Move maximum-size stack into partially filled stack
preconditions: Two stacks of the same item exist; target stack has limited free capacity
test_steps:
1. Drag the full stack onto the partial stack.
2. Inspect remainder.
3. Repeat with target exactly one item below maximum.
expected_result: Target does not exceed cap; excess remains in source or is handled by defined behavior; total quantity is conserved.

test_title: Equip and unequip while inventory is full
preconditions: Every bag slot occupied; wearable item equipped
test_steps:
1. Open equipment panel.
2. Attempt to unequip into full inventory.
3. Remove one item.
4. Repeat.
expected_result: Full-inventory action gives clear feedback and does not delete equipment; action succeeds after a free slot is available.

test_title: Craft exactly at material threshold
preconditions: Recipe costs defined amounts; player has exactly enough materials
test_steps:
1. Open crafting menu.
2. Select recipe.
3. Craft once.
4. Inspect resource balances and output.
expected_result: Exactly one item is produced; required resources are consumed once; balances never become negative.

test_title: Attempt crafting with one material short
preconditions: Recipe visible; one ingredient below requirement
test_steps:
1. Open recipe.
2. Attempt craft by mouse and controller input.
3. Check remaining materials.
expected_result: Craft action is unavailable or rejected with clear feedback; no resources are consumed; no output is produced.

test_title: Cancel crafting before completion
preconditions: Recipe has a non-instant crafting progress bar
test_steps:
1. Start crafting.
2. Cancel halfway.
3. Inspect materials.
4. Start again.
expected_result: Resources and progress follow documented cancellation rules; cancellation does not duplicate output or allow an instant second craft.

test_title: Damage received during invulnerability frames
preconditions: Character has dodge or hit-recovery invulnerability
test_steps:
1. Trigger dodge or recovery.
2. Time a known enemy attack inside active frames.
3. Repeat just outside window.
expected_result: Damage immunity applies only during valid frames; health changes correctly before and after window.

test_title: Simultaneous lethal hit and healing action
preconditions: Character has low health and a usable healing item
test_steps:
1. Allow an enemy to attack.
2. Activate heal at impact.
3. Repeat across timing offsets.
expected_result: Outcome follows defined event ordering; no negative health, duplicate healing, or soft lock occurs.

test_title: Attack against target outside hit range
preconditions: Melee weapon equipped; stationary enemy available
test_steps:
1. Attack from slightly inside effective range.
2. Move just outside.
3. Attack again.
expected_result: Hits register only in valid reach and line-of-sight; feedback matches collision and damage results.

test_title: Enemy loses target after line of sight breaks
preconditions: Enemy can chase player; cover is available
test_steps:
1. Aggro the enemy.
2. Break line of sight behind cover.
3. Wait through its search duration.
4. Reappear.
expected_result: Enemy changes states according to detection rules; it does not permanently track the hidden player without supporting cues.

test_title: Objective progress when final target is defeated
preconditions: Quest requiring a fixed number of targets is active
test_steps:
1. Defeat targets until one remains.
2. Defeat final target.
3. Inspect counter and completion state.
expected_result: Counter increments once for the final valid kill; quest completes once; rewards are not granted multiple times.

test_title: Quest objective completed before tracking starts
preconditions: An objective item can be collected before quest acceptance
test_steps:
1. Pick up objective item.
2. Accept related quest.
3. Check progress.
4. Try handing in.
expected_result: Quest uses its documented retroactive-progress rule; item cannot become permanently unusable or duplicated.

test_title: Checkpoint activation followed by player death
preconditions: Two checkpoints available in one area
test_steps:
1. Activate checkpoint A.
2. Activate checkpoint B.
3. Die.
4. Respawn.
expected_result: Respawn uses latest valid checkpoint B; world and character state match checkpoint rules.

test_title: Save with altered equipment and resource amounts
preconditions: Save/load supported; equipment and materials available
test_steps:
1. Change equipment.
2. Consume some resources.
3. Save.
4. Exit to title.
5. Load.
expected_result: Equipment selection and all item quantities match saved state; no duplicate or reverted inventory entries.

test_title: Reload after changing options
preconditions: Graphics and audio options are available
test_steps:
1. Change resolution scale and audio mix.
2. Save or apply.
3. Restart game.
4. Inspect settings.
expected_result: Settings designated as persistent retain values after relaunch; unsupported settings are reset with clear behavior.

test_title: Corrupt save file handling
preconditions: Test environment uses disposable save copies; backups available
test_steps:
1. Copy a test save.
2. Damage the copy deliberately.
3. Launch load screen.
4. Attempt to load copy.
expected_result: Corrupt save is detected gracefully; app does not crash; intact saves remain available; user receives actionable feedback.

test_title: Text scaling at smallest supported resolution
preconditions: Game provides UI/text scaling and multiple resolutions
test_steps:
1. Select lowest supported resolution.
2. Increase UI scale.
3. Open inventory, settings and pause menus.
expected_result: Buttons and text remain visible or scrollable; focus indicators are not clipped; controls can still be reached.

test_title: Controller focus after closing a modal dialog
preconditions: Controller connected; confirmation dialog accessible
test_steps:
1. Open settings.
2. Open reset-confirmation dialog.
3. Cancel.
4. Navigate with D-pad.
expected_result: Focus returns to an expected menu control; user can navigate without switching to mouse.

test_title: Subtitle visibility over bright backgrounds
preconditions: Subtitles enabled; spoken scene with light backgrounds available
test_steps:
1. Trigger spoken scene.
2. Observe subtitle contrast against bright and dark backdrops.
3. Adjust subtitle settings.
expected_result: Subtitles remain legible with available background or outline settings; timing and speaker indicators remain consistent.

test_title: Localization with long menu labels
preconditions: At least two supported languages; one expands label length
test_steps:
1. Switch language.
2. Open keybinding and graphics menus.
3. Visit confirmation dialog.
expected_result: Labels wrap or fit without covering buttons; no raw localization keys or missing glyphs appear.

test_title: Mute sound effects while dialogue continues
preconditions: Audio categories have independent sliders; a spoken scene is available
test_steps:
1. Set SFX volume to zero.
2. Trigger effect and dialogue.
3. Set voice volume to zero separately.
expected_result: Each slider affects its intended channel only; other audio channels follow their own settings.

test_title: Music transitions through pause and resume
preconditions: Gameplay music active; pause supported
test_steps:
1. Listen during play.
2. Pause for 10 seconds.
3. Resume.
4. Repeat after entering another area.
expected_result: Music pause/mixing matches design and resumes without doubled tracks, abrupt spikes or silence.

test_title: Spatial sound follows emitter movement
preconditions: Moving sound source exists; stereo headphones available
test_steps:
1. Stand still as source moves left to right.
2. Rotate camera without moving.
3. Repeat at different distances.
expected_result: Directional balance and attenuation follow relative source position without channel reversal or discontinuities.

test_title: Two clients join and leave a lobby
preconditions: Two permitted game clients/accounts; lobby feature enabled
test_steps:
1. Host creates lobby.
2. Client joins.
3. Client leaves.
4. Client rejoins.
expected_result: Both clients show consistent membership and player count; join/leave events do not create ghost slots.

test_title: Ready-state changes during host countdown
preconditions: Two clients in lobby; ready check and countdown enabled
test_steps:
1. Both clients ready up.
2. Unready one client as countdown starts.
3. Ready again.
expected_result: Countdown follows documented cancellation/restart rule; ready states agree on all clients.

test_title: Client disconnects during scene transition
preconditions: Two clients connected; host can trigger scene change
test_steps:
1. Start transition.
2. Disconnect client network.
3. Reconnect after host loads.
4. Attempt rejoin.
expected_result: Client receives clear recovery outcome; host remains playable; state sync does not produce duplicate entities.

test_title: High-latency interaction does not duplicate rewards
preconditions: Online session; controlled network impairment tool; collectable object
test_steps:
1. Add latency to client.
2. Interact repeatedly with single-use reward.
3. Restore connection.
expected_result: Reward is granted at most once per valid interaction; clients converge on authoritative object state.

test_title: Frame-time stability during rapid camera rotation
preconditions: Repeatable scene with multiple props; frame-time overlay enabled
test_steps:
1. Record 30 seconds idle.
2. Rotate camera repeatedly for 60 seconds.
3. Note frame-time spikes.
expected_result: Compare median and 1% low to baseline; investigate repeatable spikes rather than assuming a fixed FPS target.

test_title: Memory trend after repeated scene reloads
preconditions: Memory telemetry available; repeatable level reload supported
test_steps:
1. Record memory after loading.
2. Reload same scene 20 times.
3. Record memory after each pass.
expected_result: Memory stabilizes after warm-up or releases as designed; a sustained upward trend is flagged for investigation.

test_title: Inventory open-close stress test
preconditions: Inventory contains several items; telemetry available
test_steps:
1. Open and close inventory 100 times.
2. Observe input responsiveness.
3. Check memory and frame-time.
expected_result: No input lock or persistent rendering artifacts; resource usage does not grow unbounded.

test_title: Resolution switch followed by focus loss
preconditions: Windowed and fullscreen modes supported
test_steps:
1. Change resolution.
2. Alt-tab during confirmation.
3. Return before/after timer.
4. Verify chosen mode.
expected_result: Display reinitializes safely; confirmation timeout reverts if not accepted; input and cursor scaling remain correct.

test_title: Shadows and lighting restore after checkpoint load
preconditions: Dynamic lighting scene and checkpoint available
test_steps:
1. Record appearance.
2. Change shadow quality.
3. Load checkpoint.
4. Compare scene.
expected_result: Lighting is consistent with current quality setting; no missing shadows, flicker or permanently baked artifacts appear.

test_title: Ultrawide aspect-ratio safe area
preconditions: Ultrawide resolution available in supported display modes
test_steps:
1. Select ultrawide resolution.
2. Open HUD, map, inventory and pause menu.
3. Trigger notification.
expected_result: Critical UI stays within safe area and retains expected alignment; view does not expose unintended hidden level geometry.

test_title: Disconnect network while matchmaking is pending
preconditions: Network matchmaking feature enabled; test connection under user control
test_steps:
1. Start matchmaking.
2. Disconnect network.
3. Wait for timeout.
4. Restore network.
5. Retry.
expected_result: Search exits with informative error; retry starts a fresh request; UI does not remain stuck in searching state.
